nome: SCARY NIGHT AT THE BIJOU (double feature)
descricao:
A simulated double feature program at a second-run movie house in the 1940s:

Our night of spooky mayhem begins with previews of coming attractions and a cartoon followed by Bela Lugosi, George Zucco, John Carradine and a bevy of girl zombies in "Voodoo Man." Next Mantan Moreland becomes leader of a squad of the undead in one of the top-rated B-genre films the 4-star "King of the Zombies."
